source_register_contract.source_write_values: Exactly one bit 1 << (port %32), one port at a time; driver rejects port>=64 before accessing it.
source_register_contract.reconnect: Write the bit to CLR, execute wmb, then read SENSE until that bit is zero.
source_register_contract.disconnect: Write the bit to SET, execute wmb, then read SENSE until that bit is one.
source_register_contract.sense_interpretation: The callback treats1 as disconnected and0 as connected; it polls a state/handshake response separate from the command.

polling.note: This is a software polling budget with jiffy rounding and a strict-after test, not a measured one-millisecond hardware deadline.

caller_constraints.enable: When a connected bandwidth request is needed, obtain/enable node regulators; set software is_connected=true before invoking sbm_config.
caller_constraints.disable: Call sbm_config and then disable node regulators and set is_connected=false; a timeout return does not itself prevent the subsequent regulator block.
caller_constraints.commit: The disconnect/reconnect calls in msm_bus_commit_data do not capture the return value.
caller_constraints.consequence: Software is_connected, probe continuation, absent panic or a later regulator message cannot independently prove the SBM SENSE condition completed.

parent_approved_minimal_reference.CLR_and_SET: Write-one command masks; reject read transactions and any bit outside0xff without partial state change. Multi-bit mask handling is declared reference behavior; the pinned guest sequence writes one bit at a time.
parent_approved_minimal_reference.SENSE: Read-only low8 actual reference connection-state mask, not a constant success value or an alias of the request field.
parent_approved_minimal_reference.cold_state: Explicit reference connected: requested-disable mask=0, sense-disconnected mask=0, no pending transitions; not observed firmware/silicon reset state.
parent_approved_minimal_reference.reference_peer_stall_mask: Mutable reference environment input can prevent completion; precise pause/resume, reset retention, counters and VMState layout are to be finalized with implementation/test authors.
parent_approved_minimal_reference.traffic_scope: These are camera/display/venus configuration-side ports. Their real endpoint traffic is not executed by the existing QoS model. The state machine represents a declared digital reference peer, not actual DMA drain, bandwidth enforcement or power-domain readiness.

acceptance_boundary.component: Literal single-bit CLR/SET/SENSE sequences; real virtual-time completion, per-port independence, duplicate/no-op/reversal, stall/resume, strict holes/width/RO/WO/reserved masks, reset and actual migration with first observation before device MMIO.
acceptance_boundary.native: Bind the actual CI binary/source and unchanged Image/DT; inspect request/sense/pending and accepted/completed-operation state read-only while stopped, and independently inspect SBM timeout logs.
acceptance_boundary.initial_noop: In the declared cold-connected profile, the first CLR1 may be a valid idempotent request. Acceptance may establish its recorded reception and a coherent no-pending state, but must not label it an observed delayed transition.

optional_symbols_collector.output_scope: Only four named symbols, their next distinct symbol and PC offset; next-symbol span is not an independent ELF-size measurement.
